request.style: English, warm acoustic pop, clear young male vocal with female harmony, acoustic guitars, piano, light strings, soft percussion, gentle and bright, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Passover was over and the caravans went home
Mary thought he walked with cousins, Joseph thought he'd gone on
A day out on the road they searched among the friends
But he was nowhere to be found when the day came to its end

[Verse]
After three days they found him in the temple
Sitting among the teachers
Listening to them and asking them questions
Everyone who heard him was astounded

[Chorus]
Why were you searching for me
Did you not know that I must be in my Father's house
Why were you searching for me
I must be in my Father's house

[Verse]
Child, why have you done this to us, his mother said in tears
Your father and I have been searching for you in anguish
He went down with them to Nazareth and continued to obey them
And his mother treasured all these things in her heart

[Chorus]
Why were you searching for me
Did you not know that I must be in my Father's house
Why were you searching for me
I must be in my Father's house
